## Purpose

This notebook is now the reporting layer for the current `gpath` modelling workflow. It is not intended to recreate the full analysis from scratch. Instead it:

- documents the current modelling path,
- states the upstream scripts/commands that generate required artefacts where known,
- loads saved results from the current workflow,
- presents model selection, diagnostics, transfer results, and parameter-transfer summaries.

Where an upstream command is not known exactly from the repo history, that is stated explicitly.

Oracle NUTS note: in [`scripts/run_gpath_transfer_nuts.R`](/share/lab_crd/lab_crd/HighPloidy_CostBenefits/data/GlucoseStarvation/scripts/run_gpath_transfer_nuts.R), `FIT_TYPE == "oracle"` sets `stan_data$is_train <- rep(1L, stan_data$N_wells)`, so the fit target is all wells regardless of the transfer-style `line_id` and direction labels used to route the job. The current oracle directories may therefore contain multiple duplicated oracle run tags per model from reused transfer machinery; this chunk intentionally binds only one canonical oracle chain set per `model_id`.

```{r nuts-output-binding-diagnostic}
source("R/posterior_io_utils.R")

bind_one_nuts_run <- function(model_id, roots, run_tag = NULL, subdir = file.path("low_to_high", "oracle")) {
  dirs <- file.path(roots, model_id, subdir)
  dir_path <- dirs[dir.exists(dirs)][1]
  if (is.na(dir_path)) stop(sprintf("No NUTS directory found for %s under: %s", model_id, paste(roots, collapse = ", ")))

  draw_files <- list_matching_rds(dir_path, "^nuts_draws_.*\\.Rds$")
  draw_tags <- sub("^nuts_draws_(.*)\\.Rds$", "\\1", basename(draw_files))
  run_tags <- sort(unique(sub("_chain[0-9]+$", "", draw_tags)))
  if (is.null(run_tag)) run_tag <- run_tags[[1]]
  if (!(run_tag %in% run_tags)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Run tag '%s' not found in %s; available tags: %s",
      run_tag, dir_path, paste(run_tags, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  draw_files <- draw_files[sub("_chain[0-9]+$", "", draw_tags) == run_tag]

  info <- lapply(draw_files, function(path) {
    dm <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(readRDS(path))
    list(
      file = basename(path),
      chain_id = as.integer(sub("^.*_chain([0-9]+)\\.Rds$", "\\1", basename(path))),
      n_iter = nrow(dm),
      vars = colnames(dm),
      has_draw_cols = all(c(".draw", ".iteration", ".chain") %in% colnames(dm))
    )
  })

  chain_ids <- vapply(info, `[[`, integer(1), "chain_id")
  if (anyDuplicated(chain_ids)) stop(sprintf("Duplicate chain ids in %s: %s", dir_path, paste(sort(unique(chain_ids[duplicated(chain_ids)])), collapse = ", ")))
  if (!setequal(chain_ids, seq_len(max(chain_ids)))) stop(sprintf("Missing chain ids in %s; observed: %s", dir_path, paste(sort(chain_ids), collapse = ", ")))
  if (length(unique(vapply(info, `[[`, integer(1), "n_iter"))) != 1L) stop(sprintf("Iteration-count mismatch across chains in %s", dir_path))
  if (length(unique(vapply(info, `[[`, logical(1), "has_draw_cols"))) != 1L) stop(sprintf("Warmup/sampling convention mismatch across chains in %s", dir_path))

  ref_vars <- info[[1]]$vars
  bad_vars <- Filter(function(x) !setequal(x$vars, ref_vars), info)
  if (length(bad_vars)) {
    msg <- vapply(bad_vars, function(x) {
      sprintf(
        "%s | missing: [%s] | extra: [%s]",
        x$file,
        paste(setdiff(ref_vars, x$vars), collapse = ", "),
        paste(setdiff(x$vars, ref_vars), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }, character(1))
    stop(sprintf("Variable-set mismatch in %s\n%s", dir_path, paste(msg, collapse = "\n")))
  }

  list(
    draws = bind_rds_draws(draw_files[order(chain_ids)], along = "chain"),
    chain_ids = sort(chain_ids),
    run_tag = run_tag
  )
}

summarize_one_nuts_run_diagnostics <- function(bound_obj) {
  posterior::summarise_draws(
    bound_obj$draws,
    mean = mean,
    sd = stats::sd,
    rhat = posterior::rhat,
    ess_bulk = posterior::ess_bulk,
    ess_tail = posterior::ess_tail
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::rename(variable = variable)
}

diagnostic_roots <- "data/gpath_transfer_cv_nuts/gpath"
rhat_threshold <- 1.01
ess_threshold <- 400

oracle_subdir <- file.path("low_to_high", "oracle")
model_ids <- basename(list.dirs(diagnostic_roots, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE))
model_ids <- model_ids[dir.exists(file.path(diagnostic_roots, model_ids, oracle_subdir))]

extract_run_tags <- function(model_id, roots, subdir = oracle_subdir) {
  dir_path <- file.path(roots, model_id, subdir)
  draw_files <- list_matching_rds(dir_path, "^nuts_draws_.*\\.Rds$")
  sort(unique(sub("_chain[0-9]+$", "", sub("^nuts_draws_(.*)\\.Rds$", "\\1", basename(draw_files)))))
}

batch_summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_ids, function(model_id) {
  dir_path <- file.path(diagnostic_roots, model_id, oracle_subdir)
  available_run_tags <- extract_run_tags(model_id, diagnostic_roots)
  bound_path <- file.path(dir_path, "bound_nuts_draws.Rds")
  diag_path <- file.path(dir_path, "nuts_chain_diagnostics.Rds")

  if (file.exists(bound_path) && file.exists(diag_path)) {
    bound_obj <- readRDS(bound_path)
    chain_diag_df <- readRDS(diag_path)
  } else {
    bound_obj <- bind_one_nuts_run(model_id, diagnostic_roots, run_tag = available_run_tags[[1]], subdir = oracle_subdir)
    chain_diag_df <- summarize_one_nuts_run_diagnostics(bound_obj)
    saveRDS(bound_obj, bound_path)
    saveRDS(chain_diag_df, diag_path)
  }
  draws_matrix <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(bound_obj$draws)

  tibble::tibble(
    model_id = model_id,
    selected_run_tag = if (!is.null(bound_obj$run_tag)) bound_obj$run_tag else available_run_tags[[1]],
    n_available_oracle_run_tags = length(available_run_tags),
    n_draws = nrow(draws_matrix),
    n_parameters = nrow(chain_diag_df),
    n_chains = length(bound_obj$chain_ids),
    n_bad_rhat = sum(chain_diag_df$rhat > rhat_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_bad_ess_bulk = sum(chain_diag_df$ess_bulk < ess_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_bad_ess_tail = sum(chain_diag_df$ess_tail < ess_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rhat = max(chain_diag_df$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_bulk = min(chain_diag_df$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_tail = min(chain_diag_df$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}))

cat(sprintf(
  "Processed %d model ids under %s\nThresholds: rhat > %.2f, ess < %d\n",
  length(model_ids),
  diagnostic_roots,
  rhat_threshold,
  ess_threshold
))
print(as.data.frame(batch_summary_df), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r nuts-instantaneous-growth-export}
source("R/project_paths.R")
source(get_model_r_path("gpath", "v1"))
source("R/gpath_run_utils.R")
source("R/nuts_consistency_utils.R")

stan_data <- readRDS(resolve_stan_data_path())
line_ids <- sort(unique(as.integer(stan_data$line_id)))
glucose_grid <- exp(seq(log(0.0001), log(25), length.out = 25L))
resource2_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 25L)
state_grid <- expand.grid(
  glucose = glucose_grid,
  resource2 = resource2_grid,
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

growth_export_summary_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(model_ids, function(model_id) {
  dir_path <- file.path(diagnostic_roots, model_id, oracle_subdir)
  bound_obj <- readRDS(file.path(dir_path, "bound_nuts_draws.Rds"))
  growth_draws_path <- file.path(dir_path, "nuts_instantaneous_growth_draws.Rds")
  growth_summary_path <- file.path(dir_path, "nuts_instantaneous_growth_summary.Rds")

  if (file.exists(growth_draws_path) && file.exists(growth_summary_path)) {
    instantaneous_growth_df <- readRDS(growth_draws_path)
    growth_summary_df <- readRDS(growth_summary_path)
  } else {
    draws_matrix <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(bound_obj$draws)
    draw_idx <- sort(sample.int(nrow(draws_matrix), size = min(20L, nrow(draws_matrix))))

    instantaneous_growth_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(line_ids, function(line_id) {
      states <- get_line_ploidy_states(stan_data, line_id = line_id)

      dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(draw_idx, function(i_draw) {
        draw_vec <- draws_matrix[i_draw, , drop = TRUE]
        names(draw_vec) <- colnames(draws_matrix)

        parms_low <- reconstruct_draw_parameters(
          draw_vec = draw_vec,
          model_id = model_id,
          line_id = line_id,
          ploidy_metric = states$low_value
        )
        parms_high <- reconstruct_draw_parameters(
          draw_vec = draw_vec,
          model_id = model_id,
          line_id = line_id,
          ploidy_metric = states$high_value
        )

        low_growth <- vapply(
          seq_len(nrow(state_grid)),
          function(i) compute_instantaneous_net_growth_with_resource2(
            parms_low,
            glucose = state_grid$glucose[[i]],
            resource2_value = state_grid$resource2[[i]],
            extra_resource_value = 1.0
          ),
          numeric(1)
        )
        high_growth <- vapply(
          seq_len(nrow(state_grid)),
          function(i) compute_instantaneous_net_growth_with_resource2(
            parms_high,
            glucose = state_grid$glucose[[i]],
            resource2_value = state_grid$resource2[[i]],
            extra_resource_value = 1.0
          ),
          numeric(1)
        )

        tibble::tibble(
          model_id = model_id,
          line_id = line_id,
          .draw = i_draw,
          glucose = state_grid$glucose,
          resource2 = state_grid$resource2,
          low_ploidy_growth = low_growth,
          high_ploidy_growth = high_growth,
          delta_growth = high_growth - low_growth
        )
      }))
    }))

    growth_summary_df <- instantaneous_growth_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$model_id, .data$line_id, .data$glucose, .data$resource2) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_draws = dplyr::n(),
        median_delta_growth = stats::median(.data$delta_growth, na.rm = TRUE),
        q025_delta_growth = stats::quantile(.data$delta_growth, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        q975_delta_growth = stats::quantile(.data$delta_growth, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    saveRDS(instantaneous_growth_df, growth_draws_path)
    saveRDS(growth_summary_df, growth_summary_path)
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    model_id = model_id,
    n_lines = dplyr::n_distinct(instantaneous_growth_df$line_id),
    n_draws_sampled = dplyr::n_distinct(instantaneous_growth_df$.draw),
    n_surface_rows = nrow(growth_summary_df)
  )
}))

print(as.data.frame(growth_export_summary_df), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Model Selection

```{r spec-model-selection-inputs, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

source("R/project_paths.R")
source(get_model_r_path("gpath", "v1"))
source("R/gpath_run_utils.R")
source("R/model_analysis_utils.R")

project_paths <- list(
  stan_data = resolve_stan_data_path(),
  assessment_run_ids = file.path("models", "gpath", "v1", "assessment_run_ids.txt"),
  optim_root = file.path("data", "runs", "gpath", "v1", "optim"),
  report_dataset_label = "gstarvation_v1",
  transfer_optim_root = "data/gpath_transfer_cv/gpath",
  transfer_nuts_root = "data/gpath_transfer_cv_nuts/gpath",
  transfer_nuts_report_root = file.path("data", "gpath_transfer_cv_nuts", "report"),
  report_export_root = file.path("data", "report_exports", "model_analysis"),
  agent_text_path = file.path("workflow", "model_analysis.txt")
)

summarize_stan_data_condition <- function(stan_data_path, tol = 1e-12) {
  stan_data <- readRDS(stan_data_path)

  if (!all(c("ploidy_metric", "line_id") %in% names(stan_data))) {
    stop("stan_data must contain `ploidy_metric` and `line_id`.")
  }

  ploidy_metric <- as.numeric(stan_data$ploidy_metric)
  line_id <- as.integer(stan_data$line_id)
  is_train <- if ("is_train" %in% names(stan_data)) as.integer(stan_data$is_train) else rep(1L, length(line_id))
  split_meta <- attr(stan_data, "transfer_split")

  finite_ploidy <- ploidy_metric[is.finite(ploidy_metric)]
  is_null <- length(finite_ploidy) > 0L && all(abs(finite_ploidy) < tol)

  holdout_idx <- which(is_train == 0L)
  holdout_lines <- if (!is.null(split_meta$line_id)) {
    as.integer(split_meta$line_id)
  } else {
    sort(unique(line_id[holdout_idx]))
  }
  holdout_ploidies <- if (!is.null(split_meta$holdout_value)) {
    as.numeric(split_meta$holdout_value)
  } else {
    sort(unique(ploidy_metric[holdout_idx]))
  }

  if (!length(holdout_lines) || !length(holdout_ploidies)) {
    meta_path <- file.path(dirname(stan_data_path), "dataset_meta.Rds")
    if (file.exists(meta_path)) {
      dataset_meta <- readRDS(meta_path)
      if (!length(holdout_lines) && !is.null(dataset_meta$line_id)) {
        holdout_lines <- as.integer(dataset_meta$line_id)
      }
      if (!length(holdout_ploidies) && !is.null(dataset_meta$holdout_value)) {
        holdout_ploidies <- as.numeric(dataset_meta$holdout_value)
      }
    }
  }

  holdout_lines <- holdout_lines[is.finite(holdout_lines)]
  holdout_ploidies <- holdout_ploidies[is.finite(holdout_ploidies)]

  if (length(holdout_lines) > 1L) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "Multiple holdout lines in %s: %s",
      stan_data_path,
      paste(holdout_lines, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  if (length(holdout_ploidies) > 1L) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "Multiple holdout ploidies in %s: %s",
      stan_data_path,
      paste(format(holdout_ploidies, trim = TRUE), collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  data.frame(
    stan_data_path = stan_data_path,
    is_null = is_null,
    holdout_line = if (length(holdout_lines)) holdout_lines[[1]] else NA_integer_,
    holdout_ploidy = if (length(holdout_ploidies)) holdout_ploidies[[1]] else NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stan_data_summary_df <- bind_rows(lapply(unique(x$summary_df$stan_data_path), summarize_stan_data_condition))

spec_summary_df <- x$summary_df %>%
  left_join(stan_data_summary_df, by = "stan_data_path") %>%
  mutate(
    model_id = run_id,
    fit_type = case_when(
      !is.na(is_null) & is_null & !is.na(holdout_line) ~ "null",
      !is.na(is_null) & !is_null & !is.na(holdout_line) ~ "transfer",
      !is.na(is_null) & !is_null & is.na(holdout_line) & is.na(holdout_ploidy) ~ "oracle",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

transfer_predictive_df <- spec_summary_df %>%
  filter(fit_type == "transfer") %>%
  transmute(
    model_id,
    holdout_line = as.integer(holdout_line),
    holdout_ploidy = as.numeric(holdout_ploidy),
    spec_row_id_transfer = spec_row_id,
    log_lik_train_transfer = log_lik_train,
    log_lik_holdout_transfer = log_lik_holdout
  )

null_predictive_df <- spec_summary_df %>%
  filter(fit_type == "null") %>%
  transmute(
    model_id,
    holdout_line = as.integer(holdout_line),
    holdout_ploidy = as.numeric(holdout_ploidy),
    spec_row_id_null = spec_row_id,
    log_lik_train_null = log_lik_train,
    log_lik_holdout_null = log_lik_holdout
  )

predictive_transfer_df <- transfer_predictive_df %>%
  full_join(
    null_predictive_df,
    by = c("model_id", "holdout_line", "holdout_ploidy")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    transfer_gain = log_lik_holdout_transfer - log_lik_holdout_null
  ) %>%
  arrange(model_id, holdout_line, holdout_ploidy)

model_selection_df <- spec_summary_df %>%
  filter(is.na(holdout_ploidy)) %>%
  mutate(
    run_dir = optim_output_dir,
    manifest_path = file.path(optim_output_dir, "run_manifest.json"),
    manifest_stan_data = stan_data_path,
    manifest_stan_file = NA_character_,
    alias = vapply(run_id, build_model_alias, character(1), format = "text"),
    alias_plot = vapply(run_id, build_model_alias, character(1), format = "plotmath"),
    n_total = n_starts_total,
    n_finite = n_starts_valid,
    prop_within_1 = if_else(n_total > 0, n_within_1 / n_total, NA_real_),
    prop_within_5 = if_else(n_total > 0, n_within_5 / n_total, NA_real_),
    deviance = -2 * best_lp,
    AIC = 2 * k - 2 * best_lp
  ) %>%
  group_by(model_id, alias, alias_plot, dataset_label, k) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = run_label, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(delta_AIC)

selected_model_id_aic <- if (nrow(model_selection_df)) model_selection_df$model_id[[1]] else NA_character_
selected_model_id <- selected_model_id_aic
selected_model_row <- if (nrow(model_selection_df)) {
  model_selection_df %>% slice_head(n = 1)
} else {
  tibble()
}
selected_model_best_draw_vec <- NULL
if (nrow(selected_model_row)) {
  selected_draw_idx <- match(selected_model_row$spec_row_id[[1]], x$summary_df$spec_row_id)
  if (is.finite(selected_draw_idx) && !is.na(selected_draw_idx)) {
    selected_model_best_draw_vec <- x$best_draws[[selected_draw_idx]]
  }
}
```

```{r model-selection-plot, fig.width=19, fig.height=6, out.width='100%'}
if (!nrow(model_selection_df)) {
  announce_missing("Skipping model-selection plot because no spec-backed all-data ranking table was built.")
} else {
  plot_df <- model_selection_df %>%
    distinct(model_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      n_within_1 = if_else(is.na(n_within_1), 0L, as.integer(n_within_1)),
      prop_within_1 = if_else(is.na(prop_within_1), 0, prop_within_1)
    )

  alias_levels <- plot_df %>%
    arrange(delta_AIC) %>%
    pull(alias) %>%
    unique_preserve()

  alias_plot_map <- plot_df %>%
    distinct(alias, alias_plot) %>%
    tibble::deframe()

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(alias = factor(alias, levels = rev(alias_levels)))

  pareto_front <- plot_df %>%
    arrange(k, deviance) %>%
    filter(deviance == cummin(deviance)) %>%
    group_by(deviance) %>%
    slice_min(order_by = k, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(k)

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      is_pareto_front = model_id %in% pareto_front$model_id,
      pareto_fill = if_else(is_pareto_front, "firebrick", "grey35"),
      stability_fill = if_else(is_pareto_front, "firebrick", "steelblue4")
    )

  p_aic <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = alias, y = delta_AIC)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = pareto_fill)) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) unname(alias_plot_map[as.character(x)])) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = expression(Delta ~ AIC))

  p_pareto <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = k, y = deviance)) +
    geom_point(color = "grey60", size = 2.5) +
    geom_line(data = pareto_front, color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(data = pareto_front, color = "firebrick", size = 3) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = pareto_front,
      aes(label = alias_plot),
      color = "firebrick",
      direction = "both",
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      size = 3
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Effective parameters (k)", y = "Deviance")

  p_stability <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = alias, y = n_within_1)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = stability_fill)) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) unname(alias_plot_map[as.character(x)])) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Found optimum (/500)")

  p_aic + p_pareto + p_stability + plot_layout(ncol = 3)
}
```

```{r selected-global-fit-overlay, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width='100%'}
if (!exists("pareto_front") || !nrow(pareto_front)) {
  announce_missing("Skipping selected global-fit overlays because no Pareto-front models are available.")
} else {
  source("R/plot_utils.R")
  source("R/sim_utils.R")

  regenerate_selected_global_fit_overlays <- FALSE
  pareto_front_model_ids <- unique_preserve(as.character(pareto_front$model_id))

  fit_rows <- model_selection_df %>%
    distinct(model_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    filter(model_id %in% pareto_front_model_ids) %>%
    arrange(match(model_id, pareto_front_model_ids))

  draw_idx <- match(fit_rows$spec_row_id, x$summary_df$spec_row_id)
  fit_rows$best_draw_vec <- x$best_draws[draw_idx]
  keep_fit <- !is.na(draw_idx) & vapply(fit_rows$best_draw_vec, Negate(is.null), logical(1))
  fit_rows <- fit_rows[keep_fit, , drop = FALSE]

  if (!nrow(fit_rows)) {
    announce_missing("Could not resolve any Pareto-front optimisation draws for the current ranking table.")
  } else {
    stan_data_overlay <- add_group_structure(readRDS(project_paths$stan_data))
    sim_times <- seq(0, max(stan_data_overlay$t_grid), by = 0.5)
    output_dir <- file.path("dev-figs", "model_analysis", "pareto_global_fit_overlays")
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    alias_levels <- fit_rows$alias
    palette_vals <- setNames(
      grDevices::hcl.colors(length(alias_levels), palette = "Dark 3"),
      alias_levels
    )

    all_line_ids <- sort(unique(as.integer(stan_data_overlay$line_id)))

    overlay_manifest_df <- bind_rows(lapply(all_line_ids, function(target_line_id) {
      line_name_hit <- names(stan_data_overlay$line_map)[as.integer(unname(stan_data_overlay$line_map)) == target_line_id]
      target_line_name <- if (length(line_name_hit)) line_name_hit[[1]] else sprintf("line %d", target_line_id)
      out_path <- file.path(output_dir, sprintf("line_%02d_pareto_overlay.png", target_line_id))
      existed_before <- file.exists(out_path)

      if (isTRUE(regenerate_selected_global_fit_overlays) || !existed_before) {
        sim_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(fit_rows)), function(i) {
          simulate_line_from_draw(
            model_id = fit_rows$model_id[[i]],
            model_r_path = get_model_r_path("gpath", "v1"),
            draw_vec = fit_rows$best_draw_vec[[i]],
            stan_data = stan_data_overlay,
            line_id = target_line_id,
            times = sim_times,
            line_name = target_line_name,
            extra_cols = list(
              group_1 = fit_rows$alias[[i]],
              run_label = fit_rows$run_label[[i]]
            )
          )
        }))

        obs_df <- build_obs_df_from_stan_data(
          stan_data = stan_data_overlay,
          line_id = target_line_id,
          line_name = target_line_name
        )

        plt <- plot_fit_overlays(
          sim_df = sim_df,
          obs_df = obs_df,
          color_by = "group_1",
          color_values = palette_vals,
          color_label = "Model",
          title = target_line_name,
          print_plot = FALSE
        )

        ggsave(
          filename = out_path,
          plot = plt,
          width = 12,
          height = 6,
          units = "in",
          dpi = 200
        )

        status <- if (existed_before) "regenerated" else "generated"
      } else {
        status <- "cached"
      }

      tibble(
        line_id = target_line_id,
        line_name = target_line_name,
        output_path = out_path,
        status = status
      )
    }))

    print(as.data.frame(overlay_manifest_df), row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r predictive-transfer-heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=7, out.width='100%'}
if (!nrow(predictive_transfer_df)) {
  announce_missing("Skipping predictive-transfer heatmap because no transfer/null pairings were built from x.")
} else {
  positive_gains <- predictive_transfer_df$transfer_gain[predictive_transfer_df$transfer_gain > 0]
  if (length(positive_gains)) {
    fill_cap <- 1.5 * max(positive_gains, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    fill_cap <- max(abs(predictive_transfer_df$transfer_gain), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  plot_df <- predictive_transfer_df %>%
    mutate(
      model_id = factor(model_id, levels = rev(unique_preserve(model_selection_df$model_id))),
      holdout_line = factor(holdout_line, levels = sort(unique(holdout_line))),
      holdout_panel = case_when(
        is.na(holdout_ploidy) ~ NA_character_,
        abs(holdout_ploidy) < 1e-12 ~ "Held out low",
        TRUE ~ "Held out high"
      ),
      holdout_panel = factor(holdout_panel, levels = c("Held out low", "Held out high"))
    )

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = holdout_line, y = model_id, fill = transfer_gain)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_grid(. ~ holdout_panel, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3b4cc0",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b40426",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-fill_cap, fill_cap),
      oob = scales::squish,
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "Holdout line",
      y = "Model ID",
      fill = sprintf("Transfer gain\n(saturated beyond +/- %.0f)", fill_cap)
    ) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
    )
}
```

```{r parameter-transfer-from-x, include=FALSE}
source("R/parameter_transfer_utils.R")

extract_raw_theta_ploidy_df <- function(draw_vec, model_id) {
  dims <- parse_run_id(model_id)
  parameter_labels <- get_param_names(
    R = dims$R,
    P = dims$P,
    W = dims$W,
    C = dims$C,
    M = dims$M,
    priors = base_priors
  )
  coefficient_names <- sprintf("raw_theta_ploidy[%d]", seq_along(parameter_labels))
  values <- unname(draw_vec[coefficient_names])

  tibble(
    parameter = parameter_labels,
    coefficient = coefficient_names,
    value = values,
    missing = is.na(values)
  )
}

raw_theta_parameter_alias_map <- c(
  "ae[1]" = "ae[1]",
  "ah[1]" = "ah[1]",
  "Y_R[1]" = "Y_R[1]",
  "m" = "m"
)

apply_parameter_alias <- function(parameter, alias_map = raw_theta_parameter_alias_map) {
  out <- unname(alias_map[parameter])
  out[is.na(out) | !nzchar(out)] <- parameter[is.na(out) | !nzchar(out)]
  out
}

if (!exists("line_label_map")) {
  stan_data_for_labels <- readRDS(project_paths$stan_data)
  line_label_map <- make_line_label_map(stan_data_for_labels$line_map)
}

parameter_transfer_base_df <- spec_summary_df %>%
  filter(fit_type %in% c("null", "transfer", "oracle")) %>%
  transmute(
    model_id,
    fit_type,
    holdout_line = as.integer(holdout_line),
    holdout_ploidy = as.numeric(holdout_ploidy),
    spec_row_id,
    run_label,
    draw_idx = match(spec_row_id, x$summary_df$spec_row_id),
    draw_vec = x$best_draws[draw_idx]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (fit_type %in% c("null", "transfer") & !is.na(holdout_line) & !is.na(holdout_ploidy)) |
      (fit_type == "oracle")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model_id, fit_type, holdout_line, holdout_ploidy) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = run_label, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-run_label)

oracle_raw_theta_df <- parameter_transfer_base_df %>%
  filter(fit_type == "oracle") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(compare_parameter_df = list(
    if (is.null(draw_vec)) {
      NULL
    } else {
      extract_raw_theta_ploidy_df(draw_vec = draw_vec, model_id = model_id)
    }
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(model_id, compare_parameter_df) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(compare_parameter_df)

common_raw_theta_parameters_from_x <- oracle_raw_theta_df %>%
  filter(!missing) %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  summarise(n_models_present = n_distinct(model_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_models_present == n_distinct(oracle_raw_theta_df$model_id)) %>%
  pull(parameter)

oracle_parameter_df <- parameter_transfer_base_df %>%
  filter(fit_type == "oracle") %>%
  select(model_id, spec_row_id_oracle = spec_row_id, draw_vec_oracle = draw_vec)

parameter_transfer_long_df <- parameter_transfer_base_df %>%
  filter(fit_type %in% c("null", "transfer")) %>%
  left_join(oracle_parameter_df, by = "model_id") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    compare_parameter_df = list(
      if (is.null(draw_vec) || is.null(draw_vec_oracle) || is.na(holdout_line) || is.na(holdout_ploidy)) {
        NULL
      } else {
        fit_df <- extract_raw_theta_ploidy_df(
          draw_vec = draw_vec,
          model_id = model_id
        ) %>%
          rename(fit_value = value)

        oracle_df <- extract_raw_theta_ploidy_df(
          draw_vec = draw_vec_oracle,
          model_id = model_id
        ) %>%
          rename(oracle_value = value)

        left_join(
          fit_df %>% select(parameter, fit_value),
          oracle_df %>% select(parameter, oracle_value),
          by = "parameter"
        )
      }
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

parameter_transfer_summary_df <- parameter_transfer_long_df %>%
  select(
    model_id,
    fit_type,
    holdout_line,
    holdout_ploidy,
    spec_row_id,
    spec_row_id_oracle,
    compare_parameter_df
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(compare_parameter_df) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(model_id, holdout_line, holdout_ploidy, parameter, spec_row_id_oracle, oracle_value),
    names_from = fit_type,
    values_from = c(spec_row_id, fit_value),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{fit_type}"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    model_id,
    holdout_line,
    holdout_ploidy,
    parameter,
    spec_row_id_null,
    spec_row_id_transfer,
    spec_row_id_oracle,
    null_value = fit_value_null,
    transfer_value = fit_value_transfer,
    oracle_value = oracle_value,
    null_vs_oracle_diff = null_value - oracle_value,
    transfer_vs_oracle_diff = transfer_value - oracle_value,
    abs_null_vs_oracle_diff = abs(null_value - oracle_value),
    abs_transfer_vs_oracle_diff = abs(transfer_value - oracle_value),
    transfer_improvement_over_null = abs(null_value - oracle_value) - abs(transfer_value - oracle_value)
  ) %>%
  arrange(model_id, holdout_line, holdout_ploidy, match(parameter, common_raw_theta_parameters_from_x))
```

```{r parameter-transfer-from-x-heatmaps, fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
if (!exists("plot_parameter_transfer_df") || !nrow(plot_parameter_transfer_df)) {
  announce_missing("No raw_theta_ploidy comparison rows available for heatmap summaries from x.")
} else {
  heatmap_df <- plot_parameter_transfer_df %>%
    group_by(model_id, parameter_label, holdout_panel) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_improvement = mean(transfer_improvement_over_null, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lines_improved = mean(transfer_improvement_over_null > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_lines = dplyr::n_distinct(holdout_line_label),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  mean_cap <- max(abs(heatmap_df$mean_improvement), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(mean_cap) || mean_cap <= 0) {
    mean_cap <- 1
  }

  p_mean <- ggplot(
    heatmap_df,
    aes(x = parameter_label, y = model_id, fill = mean_improvement)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_grid(. ~ holdout_panel, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#3b4cc0",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b40426",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-mean_cap, mean_cap),
      oob = scales::squish,
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Model ID",
      fill = "Mean improvement\n|null-oracle| - |transfer-oracle|"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
    )

  p_frac <- ggplot(
    heatmap_df,
    aes(x = parameter_label, y = model_id, fill = frac_lines_improved)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_grid(. ~ holdout_panel, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white",
      high = "#1b9e77",
      limits = c(0, 1),
      na.value = "grey90"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Model ID",
      fill = "Fraction of held-out\ncell lines improved"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
    )

  p_mean / p_frac
}
```

## Leave-One-Line-Out `raw_theta_ploidy` Fits

These rows are the best `transfer` fits for each held-out line and direction, with the corresponding `raw_theta_ploidy` values and fit scores attached.


```{r transfer-raw-theta-ploidy-plot, fig.height=12, fig.width=14}
if (!nrow(raw_theta_ploidy_transfer_df)) {
  announce_missing("No leave-one-line-out transfer best-fit raw_theta_ploidy coefficients available for plotting.")
} else {
  transfer_plot_df <- raw_theta_ploidy_transfer_df %>%
    filter(fit_type == "transfer", parameter %in% common_raw_theta_parameters, !missing)

  if (!nrow(transfer_plot_df)) {
    announce_missing("No transfer-fit raw_theta_ploidy coefficients available for common parameters.")
  } else {
  global_plot_df <- raw_theta_ploidy_global_df %>%
    filter(parameter %in% common_raw_theta_parameters, !missing) %>%
    transmute(
      model_id,
      alias,
      line_id = NA_integer_,
      parameter,
      raw_theta_ploidy
    )

  transfer_plot_df <- transfer_plot_df %>%
    transmute(
      model_id,
      alias,
      line_id,
      line_label = label_line_ids(line_id, line_label_map, as_factor = FALSE),
      direction,
      parameter,
      raw_theta_ploidy
    )

  line_levels <- label_line_ids(sort(unique(transfer_plot_df$line_id)), line_label_map, as_factor = FALSE)

  global_repeated_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    global_plot_df,
    line_label = line_levels
  )

  transfer_with_global_df <- transfer_plot_df %>%
    left_join(
      global_plot_df %>%
        select(model_id, parameter, global_raw_theta_ploidy = raw_theta_ploidy),
      by = c("model_id", "parameter")
    )

  line_df <- transfer_with_global_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(global_raw_theta_ploidy)) %>%
    transmute(
      parameter,
      model_id,
      line_label,
      direction,
      x = model_id,
      y = global_raw_theta_ploidy,
      xend = model_id,
      yend = raw_theta_ploidy
    )

  plot_df <- bind_rows(
    global_repeated_df %>% mutate(point_type = "global", direction = "global"),
    transfer_plot_df %>% mutate(point_type = "transfer")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("global", "low_to_high", "high_to_low")),
      model_id = factor(model_id, levels = ranking_model_levels(ranking_df)),
      line_label = factor(
        line_label,
        levels = line_levels
      ),
      parameter = factor(parameter, levels = common_raw_theta_parameters)
    )

  ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = model_id, y = raw_theta_ploidy)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_segment(
      data = line_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, color = direction),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df %>% filter(direction == "global"),
      shape = 21,
      size = 2.8,
      stroke = 0.7,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df %>% filter(direction != "global"),
      aes(color = direction),
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0),
      alpha = 0.8,
      size = 2.2
    ) +
    facet_grid(parameter ~ line_label, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(low_to_high = "#1b9e77", high_to_low = "#d95f02")) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Best-fit raw_theta_ploidy",
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  }
}
```

```{r transfer-raw-theta-ploidy-summary}
if (!nrow(raw_theta_ploidy_transfer_df)) {
  announce_missing("No leave-one-line-out transfer best-fit raw_theta_ploidy coefficients available for directional-agreement summary.")
} else {
  global_sign_df <- raw_theta_ploidy_global_df %>%
    filter(parameter %in% focus_common_parameters, !missing) %>%
    transmute(
      model_id,
      parameter = normalize_focus_parameter(parameter),
      global_raw_theta_ploidy = raw_theta_ploidy,
      global_sign = sign(raw_theta_ploidy)
    )

  agreement_df <- raw_theta_ploidy_transfer_df %>%
    filter(fit_type == "transfer", !missing) %>%
    mutate(parameter = normalize_focus_parameter(parameter)) %>%
    filter(parameter %in% focus_common_parameters) %>%
    left_join(global_sign_df, by = c("model_id", "parameter")) %>%
    mutate(
      transfer_sign = sign(raw_theta_ploidy),
      directional_agreement = !is.na(global_sign) & !is.na(transfer_sign) & (global_sign == transfer_sign)
    )

  by_parameter_df <- agreement_df %>%
    group_by(parameter) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cases = dplyr::n(),
      prop_directional_agreement = mean(directional_agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_abs_shift_from_global = mean(abs(raw_theta_ploidy - global_raw_theta_ploidy), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(parameter, focus_common_parameters))
  raw_theta_agreement_summary_df <- by_parameter_df
  raw_theta_agreement_model_df <- agreement_df %>%
    group_by(model_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cases = dplyr::n(),
      prop_directional_agreement = mean(directional_agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_abs_shift_from_global = mean(abs(raw_theta_ploidy - global_raw_theta_ploidy), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(prop_directional_agreement), mean_abs_shift_from_global, model_id)
  raw_theta_agreement_direction_df <- agreement_df %>%
    group_by(direction, parameter) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cases = dplyr::n(),
      prop_directional_agreement = mean(directional_agreement, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_abs_shift_from_global = mean(abs(raw_theta_ploidy - global_raw_theta_ploidy), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(direction, match(parameter, focus_common_parameters))

  cat("Directional agreement of transfer `raw_theta_ploidy` with the global all-data fit\n\n")
  print(as.data.frame(by_parameter_df), row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nAgreement summary by model\n\n")
  print(as.data.frame(raw_theta_agreement_model_df), row.names = FALSE)

  cat("\nAgreement summary by transfer direction and parameter\n\n")
  print(as.data.frame(raw_theta_agreement_direction_df), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Transfer Screening Across Models

```{r screening-plots, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
if (!nrow(screen_transfer_df) || !nrow(screen_parameter_df)) {
  announce_missing("Need both predictive and parameter-transfer screening outputs to draw compact model-screening plots.")
} else {
  screen_parameter_df <- screen_parameter_df %>%
    mutate(
      mean_log_error_improvement = mean_abs_log_null_holdout_ratio - mean_abs_log_holdout_ratio,
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("low_to_high", "high_to_low"))
    )

  p_pred <- ggplot(
    screen_transfer_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, transfer_gain, FUN = mean), y = transfer_gain, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Predictive transfer gain over null")

  p_param_log <- ggplot(
    screen_parameter_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, mean_log_error_improvement, FUN = mean), y = mean_log_error_improvement, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Mean log-error improvement over null")

  p_param_win <- ggplot(
    screen_parameter_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, prop_parameters_transfer_better_than_null, FUN = mean), y = prop_parameters_transfer_better_than_null, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Proportion of parameters transfer beats null")

  (p_pred | p_param_log) / p_param_win
  }
```

## Transfer Fit Diagnostics On Common Well Subsets

These diagnostics evaluate each best `null`, `transfer`, and `oracle` fit on the same transfer-defined well subsets, rather than comparing each fit on its own training set.

Interpretation:

- `transfer - null > 0` means the transferred fit scores better than the null fit on the same subset.
- `transfer - oracle < 0` means the transferred fit is still worse than the oracle on the same subset, which is expected if oracle is the best attainable benchmark.
- holdout-well panels are the main predictive check; training-well panels mostly indicate whether transfer is overfitting or underfitting relative to the other fit types.

```{r transfer-subset-diagnostics, fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
if (!nrow(transfer_subset_summary_df)) {
  announce_missing("No common-subset transfer diagnostics could be built from saved best-start fits.")
} else {
  diag_df <- transfer_subset_summary_df %>%
    mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = c("low_to_high", "high_to_low")))

  p1 <- ggplot(
    diag_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, transfer_minus_oracle_train, FUN = mean), y = transfer_minus_oracle_train, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Transfer - Oracle on transfer-training wells")

  p2 <- ggplot(
    diag_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, transfer_minus_null_train, FUN = mean), y = transfer_minus_null_train, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Transfer - Null on transfer-training wells")

  p3 <- ggplot(
    diag_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, transfer_minus_oracle_holdout, FUN = mean), y = transfer_minus_oracle_holdout, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Transfer - Oracle on transfer-holdout wells")

  p4 <- ggplot(
    diag_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, transfer_minus_null_holdout, FUN = mean), y = transfer_minus_null_holdout, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Transfer - Null on transfer-holdout wells")

  (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)
}
```

```{r transfer-direction-asymmetry, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
if (!nrow(transfer_subset_summary_df)) {
  announce_missing("No common-subset transfer diagnostics available for direction-asymmetry plot.")
} else {
  asym_df <- transfer_subset_summary_df %>%
    select(model_id, line_id, direction, transfer_minus_oracle_train, transfer_minus_null_train) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = direction,
      values_from = c(transfer_minus_oracle_train, transfer_minus_null_train)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      asym_transfer_minus_oracle_train =
        transfer_minus_oracle_train_low_to_high - transfer_minus_oracle_train_high_to_low,
      asym_transfer_minus_null_train =
        transfer_minus_null_train_low_to_high - transfer_minus_null_train_high_to_low
    )

  p1 <- ggplot(
    asym_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, asym_transfer_minus_oracle_train, FUN = mean), y = asym_transfer_minus_oracle_train)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2, color = "#1b9e77") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Low->High minus High->Low\nfor Transfer - Oracle on training wells")

  p2 <- ggplot(
    asym_df,
    aes(x = reorder(model_id, asym_transfer_minus_null_train, FUN = mean), y = asym_transfer_minus_null_train)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), alpha = 0.8, size = 2, color = "#d95f02") +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 7, color = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Low->High minus High->Low\nfor Transfer - Null on training wells")

  p1 | p2
}
```

## NUTS Posterior Consistency

This section reads precomputed summaries generated from the oracle NUTS fits under `data/gpath_transfer_cv_nuts/gpath/<MODEL_ID>/low_to_high/oracle/`. The expected inputs live under `data/gpath_transfer_cv_nuts/report/` and can be refreshed with `scripts/agentRrunner.sh scripts/summarize_gpath_nuts_consistency.R`. The focus remains the common mechanistic parameters `ae[1]`, `ah[1]`, `Y_R[1]`, and `m`, plus the implied instantaneous net growth curves across the observed glucose conditions when auxiliary resource 2 is fixed at 1 and waste is set to 0.

The model-level Pareto-front interval and growth-curve figures are shown near the top of the report immediately after model selection.

```{r nuts-growth-curves-by-model, fig.height=10, fig.width=16, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
      model_id = factor(model_id, levels = ranking_model_levels(ranking_df)),
      line_label = label_line_ids(line_id, line_label_map),
      ploidy_label = factor(ploidy_label, levels = c("low_ploidy", "high_ploidy"), labels = c("Low ploidy", "High ploidy"))
    )

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = glucose, y = median_growth, color = ploidy_label, fill = ploidy_label)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q025_growth, ymax = q975_growth), alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.3) +
    facet_grid(line_label ~ model_id, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Low ploidy" = "#1b9e77", "High ploidy" = "#d95f02")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Low ploidy" = "#1b9e77", "High ploidy" = "#d95f02")) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_x_log10()+
    labs(
      x = "Initial glucose",
      y = "Instantaneous net growth",
      color = "",
      fill = ""
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
    )
}
```

## Focused Common Parameters

These plots break out the four parameters that are present across the ranked model set: `ae[1]`, `ah[1]`, `Y_R[1]`, and `m`. The ratio view uses signed log-ratios to the oracle on the reconstructed held-out parameters, while the hit summaries below retain the same absolute-log-ratio win criteria used elsewhere in the notebook.


```{r focused-parameter-table}
if (!nrow(focused_parameter_df)) {
  announce_missing("No focused parameter-transfer comparison rows found for the common parameters.")
} else {
  parameter_summary_df <- focused_parameter_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(abs_log_null_ratio), !is.na(abs_log_transfer_ratio)) %>%
    group_by(parameter, direction) %>%
    summarise(
      n_cases = dplyr::n(),
      mean_ratio_error_improvement = mean(ratio_error_improvement, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_ratio_error_improvement = median(ratio_error_improvement, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_transfer_better_than_null = mean(transfer_beats_null_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(parameter, direction)
  model_parameter_summary_df <- focused_parameter_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(abs_log_null_ratio), !is.na(abs_log_transfer_ratio)) %>%
    group_by(model_id, parameter) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_ratio_error_improvement = mean(ratio_error_improvement, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_transfer_better_than_null = mean(transfer_beats_null_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(parameter, desc(mean_ratio_error_improvement), desc(prop_transfer_better_than_null), model_id)

  cat("Across-model summary by parameter and transfer direction\n\n")
  print(as.data.frame(parameter_summary_df), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nModel-level summary by parameter\n\n")
  print(as.data.frame(model_parameter_summary_df), row.names = FALSE)
  emit_artifact_note("focused_parameter_df")
}
```

```{r focused-parameter-ratio, fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
if (!nrow(focused_parameter_df %>% filter(!is.na(abs_log_null_ratio), !is.na(abs_log_transfer_ratio)))) {
  announce_missing("No positive-valued focused parameter rows available for ratio-based plotting.")
} else {
  plot_df <- focused_parameter_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(abs_log_null_ratio), !is.na(abs_log_transfer_ratio)) %>%
    mutate(
      parameter = factor(parameter, levels = focus_common_parameters),
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("low_to_high", "high_to_low")),
      model_id = factor(model_id, levels = ranking_model_levels(ranking_df))
    )

  p1 <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = model_id)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_segment(
      aes(
        xend = model_id,
        y = log_null_ratio,
        yend = log_transfer_ratio,
        color = direction
      ),
      linewidth = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(y = log_null_ratio), shape = 21, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.7, fill = "white", color = "black") +
    geom_point(aes(y = log_transfer_ratio, color = direction), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_grid(parameter ~ line_direction, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(low_to_high = "#1b9e77", high_to_low = "#d95f02")) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "log(fit / oracle) on reconstructed held-out parameter",
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = model_id, y = ratio_error_improvement, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), size = 2.1, alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_grid(parameter ~ line_direction, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(low_to_high = "#1b9e77", high_to_low = "#d95f02")) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "|log(null/oracle)| - |log(transfer/oracle)|",
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  p1 / p2
}
```

```{r focused-parameter-hit-summary, fig.height=8, fig.width=14}
if (!nrow(focused_parameter_df %>% filter(!is.na(abs_log_null_ratio), !is.na(abs_log_transfer_ratio)))) {
  announce_missing("No positive-valued focused parameter rows available for hit-summary plotting.")
} else {
  hit_df <- focused_parameter_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(abs_log_null_ratio), !is.na(abs_log_transfer_ratio)) %>%
    group_by(model_id, direction, parameter) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_log_error_improvement = mean(ratio_error_improvement, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_log_error_improvement = median(ratio_error_improvement, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_transfer_better_than_null = mean(transfer_beats_null_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_cases = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      parameter = factor(parameter, levels = focus_common_parameters),
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("low_to_high", "high_to_low")),
      model_id = factor(model_id, levels = ranking_model_levels(ranking_df))
    )
  focused_hit_df <- hit_df
  audit_index_df <- bind_rows(audit_index_df, write_audit_artifact(hit_df, "focused_parameter_hit_df"))

  p1 <- ggplot(
    hit_df,
    aes(x = model_id, y = mean_log_error_improvement, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey75", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(low_to_high = "#1b9e77", high_to_low = "#d95f02")) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Mean log-error improvement over null",
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(
    hit_df,
    aes(x = model_id, y = prop_transfer_better_than_null, color = direction)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "grey75", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(low_to_high = "#1b9e77", high_to_low = "#d95f02")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "",
      y = "Proportion transfer beats null",
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  p1 / p2
  emit_artifact_note("focused_parameter_hit_df")
}
```

## Cross-Model Family Transfer

This section asks a narrower question than overall model transfer: whether particular parameter families repeatedly move closer to the oracle than the null baseline does across models, lines, and transfer directions.

```{r parameter-family-ranking, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
if (!nrow(model_family_summary_df)) {
  announce_missing("No parameter-comparison outputs found for family-level transfer analysis.")
} else {
  plot_df <- family_ranking_df %>%
    mutate(
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("low_to_high", "high_to_low")),
      family = reorder(family, mean_log_error_improvement)
    )

  p1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = family, y = mean_log_error_improvement, color = direction)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ direction, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Cross-model mean log-error improvement")

  p2 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = family, y = mean_win_rate, color = direction)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ direction, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = "Cross-model mean family win rate")

  p1 | p2
}
```

## Cross-Model Derived Glucose Summaries

These plots summarize five glucose-focused derived quantities reconstructed from the parameter states:
`Umax_1 = ae1`, `Khalf_1 = ah1`, `Efflow_1 = ae1 / ah1`, `YieldCap_1 = Y_R1 * ae1`, and `NetGrow_1 = Y_R1 * ae1 - m`.

```{r derived-transfer-selected-model, fig.height=9, fig.width=10}
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "Derived glucose summary", y = "Transfer beats null") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

    p1 / p2
  }
}
```

## Transfer Analysis: Parameter View

This is currently the biologically primary transfer analysis. The null baseline is the observed-state parameterisation carried forward unchanged to the held-out ploidy state.

```{r parameter-transfer-summary}
if (is.na(selected_model_id)) {
  announce_missing("No selected model available for parameter transfer summary.")
} else {
  optim_transfer <- load_transfer_outputs(selected_model_id, output_root = project_paths$transfer_optim_root)

  if (is.null(optim_transfer$parameter_summary)) {
    announce_missing("No parameter transfer summary found for %s", selected_model_id)
  } else {
    optim_transfer$parameter_summary %>%
      mutate(
        mean_log_error_improvement = mean_abs_log_null_holdout_ratio - mean_abs_log_holdout_ratio
      ) %>%
      select(
        line_id,
        direction,
        mean_log_error_improvement,
        prop_parameters_transfer_better_than_null,
        mean_abs_log_holdout_ratio,
        mean_abs_log_null_holdout_ratio
      ) %>%
      arrange(direction, desc(mean_log_error_improvement)) %>%
      print()
  }
}
```

## Transfer Fits For A Representative Line

This section overlays the best optimisation `null`, `transfer`, and `oracle` fits for one selected line. A line is chosen from the parameter-transfer summary by maximal mean log-error improvement over null; if that summary is absent, line 1 is used.

```{r transfer-overlay-plot, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
if (is.na(selected_model_id)) {
  announce_missing("No selected model available for transfer overlay plot.")
} else {
  parameter_summary_path <- file.path(project_paths$transfer_optim_root, selected_model_id, "parameter_transfer_summary.Rds")
  parameter_summary_df <- safe_read_rds(parameter_summary_path)

  target_line <- 1L
  if (!is.null(parameter_summary_df) && nrow(parameter_summary_df)) {
    score <- parameter_summary_df$mean_abs_log_null_holdout_ratio - parameter_summary_df$mean_abs_log_holdout_ratio
    target_line <- parameter_summary_df$line_id[which.max(score)]
  }

  best_start_path <- file.path(project_paths$transfer_optim_root, selected_model_id, "transfer_best_start_summary.Rds")
  if (!file.exists(best_start_path)) {
    announce_missing("No transfer best-start summary found at %s", best_start_path)
  } else {
    plot_data <- build_transfer_overlay_plot_data(
      model_id = selected_model_id,
      line_id = target_line,
      output_root = "data/gpath_transfer_cv",
      stan_data_path = project_paths$stan_data
    )

    plot_fit_overlays(
      sim_df = plot_data$sim_df,
      obs_df = plot_data$obs_df,
      color_by = "group_1",
      linetype_by = "group_2",
      color_values = c(null = "#6f6f6f", transfer = "#1b9e77", oracle = "#d95f02"),
      linetype_values = c(low_to_high = "solid", high_to_low = "22"),
      color_label = "Fit",
      linetype_label = "Direction",
      title = sprintf(
        "Transfer CV Fits | Model: %s | Cell Line: %s",
        selected_model_id,
        plot_data$context$line_name
      ),
      subtitle = plot_data$score_text
    )
  }
}
```

## Current Interpretation

Interpretation here is based on two distinct questions:

- predictive transfer: does the transferred ploidy effect improve held-out predictive fit relative to the null?
- parameter transfer: does the transferred ploidy effect move reconstructed held-out parameters closer to the oracle than the null does?

```{r current-interpretation-gloss}
metric_glossary_df %>%
  filter(metric %in% c("transfer_gain", "transfer_regret", "mean_log_error_improvement", "prop_parameters_transfer_better_than_null")) %>%
  print(row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r interpretation-table}
if (is.na(selected_model_id)) {
  announce_missing("No selected model available for interpretation summary.")
} else {
  optim_transfer <- load_transfer_outputs(selected_model_id, output_root = project_paths$transfer_optim_root)

  if (is.null(optim_transfer$parameter_summary) || is.null(optim_transfer$transfer_summary)) {
    announce_missing("Need both predictive and parameter-transfer summaries to build the interpretation table.")
  } else {
    interpretation_df <- optim_transfer$parameter_summary %>%
      mutate(
        mean_log_error_improvement = mean_abs_log_null_holdout_ratio - mean_abs_log_holdout_ratio
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        optim_transfer$transfer_summary %>% rename(model_direction = direction),
        by = c("line_id" = "line_id", "direction" = "model_direction")
      ) %>%
      select(
        line_id,
        direction,
        transfer,
        null,
        oracle,
        transfer_gain,
        transfer_regret,
        mean_log_error_improvement,
        prop_parameters_transfer_better_than_null,
        mean_abs_log_holdout_ratio,
        mean_abs_log_null_holdout_ratio
      )

    print(interpretation_df)
  }
}
```

```{r interpretation-takeaway, results='asis'}
if (nrow(selected_model_summary_df) || nrow(shortlist_df)) {
  shortlist_note <- if (nrow(shortlist_df)) {
    paste(shortlist_df$model_id, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "no aggregated shortlist"
  }
  shortlist_verdict <- if (nrow(shortlist_df)) {
    pos_pred <- shortlist_df %>% filter(!is.na(mean_transfer_gain), mean_transfer_gain > 0)
    pos_param <- shortlist_df %>% filter(!is.na(mean_parameter_log_error_improvement), mean_parameter_log_error_improvement > 0)
    if (!nrow(pos_pred) && !nrow(pos_param)) {
      "Across the shortlist, there is no model that is positive on average for either predictive transfer or parameter transfer."
    } else if (nrow(pos_pred) && !nrow(pos_param)) {
      "Across the shortlist, some models improve predictive transfer, but none show positive average parameter-transfer improvement."
    } else if (!nrow(pos_pred) && nrow(pos_param)) {
      "Across the shortlist, some models improve parameter transfer, but none show positive average predictive transfer gain."
    } else {
      "Across the shortlist, at least some models are positive on both predictive and parameter-transfer summaries."
    }
  } else {
    "No shortlist-level verdict could be formed."
  }
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
    paste(
      "**Interpretation.**",
      "Primary interpretation should now be based on the aggregated shortlist rather than a single winner.",
      sprintf("The current shortlist is: %s.", shortlist_note),
      shortlist_verdict,
      if (nrow(selected_model_summary_df)) sprintf("For single-model views, the representative model is `%s`.", selected_model_summary_df$model_id[[1]]) else "",
      "The predictive summaries remain a benchmark, but parameter transfer is still the more direct scientific readout."
    )
  ))
}
```

## Notes And Next Steps

At the time of writing, the modelling workflow supports four distinct questions:

1. Which `gpath` structure is best supported by the hierarchical optimisation fits?
2. Are selected models numerically stable enough to interpret?
3. Does a shared ploidy effect improve held-out prediction in directional transfer tests?
4. Does that same shared ploidy effect move held-out-line parameter values closer to the oracle fit than a null baseline does?

Recommended next steps:

1. Treat the selected `gpath` model as primary and stop comparing many model IDs throughout the downstream biological analysis.
2. Use the predictive transfer summaries as a benchmark, but make the parameter-transfer section the primary scientific result.
3. The current `oracle` transfer fits rerun the same all-data objective that the main global optimisation already solves when the model spec and ploidy mask are unchanged. That is redundant work and makes the workflow harder to follow; downstream comparisons should either reuse the global fit directly or state clearly why a separate all-data rerun is needed.
4. Add one compact comparison of optimisation-based versus NUTS-based transfer for the same selected model to quantify how much posterior averaging changes the conclusion.
5. If the parameter-transfer summaries are still hard to interpret, lean on the focused common-parameter plots and relative-error summaries before moving up to family-level averages.
6. Keep legacy or exploratory analysis blocks outside this notebook unless they are directly needed for the current `gpath` narrative.
